page.overview:
Who is Orion Amari?

Orion Amari was a wizard who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 1984, during which he became a Chaser and eventually also the Captain of the Quidditch team of his house; playing alongside Skye Parkin and Jacob's sibling.

Orion was an orphan, but he considered his Quidditch team to be his family.

During his time at Hogwarts, Orion was Sorted into an unknown house. At some point during his time at school, he became a Chaser and the Captain of an unknown Hogwarts Quidditch team.

After graduating from Hogwarts, he became a life coach. People sought him out for answers to difficult questions. Most of his clients were quite wealthy.
